Title: Hard-coded Google Maps API Key
Analysis:
- Source: Static constant definition in source code (demoOrder.ts).
- Sanitization/Validation: None; the API key is directly hardcoded into the source code rather than retrieved from secure environment variables or a secret manager.
- Sink: The sensitive API key string "AIzaSyD-mock-key-for-guardrails-demo-4402" is stored directly in source code and partially exposed in the `processOrder` response.
- Conceptual Exploit Payload:
  An attacker inspecting the source repository or bundle can extract the key:
  `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY = "AIzaSyD-mock-key-for-guardrails-demo-4402"`
  and make unauthorized API calls to Google Maps services at the expense and permissions of the application owner:
  ```http
  GET /maps/api/geocode/json?address=1600+Amphitheatre+Parkway&key=AIzaSyD-mock-key-for-guardrails-demo-4402 HTTP/1.1
  Host: maps.googleapis.com
  ```
